name: base
purpose: regular 30 ns clock, three or four samples per 100 ns update; vin steps between updates; a 36 ns pulse between two updates that the filter must not see; slow ramps; a long negative input that drives the held value negative; a four-sample reset while vin steps; a short rst pulse that covers no sample
netlist:
simulator lang=spectre
global 0

ahdl_include "dut.va"

Vvin (vin 0) vsource type=pwl wave=[0 0 135.5n 0 136.5n 0.8 305n 0.8 385n 0.3 421.5n 0.3 422.5n -0.6 457.5n -0.6 458.5n 0.3 561.5n 0.3 562.5n 0.9 705.5n 0.9 706.5n -0.9 1040n -0.9 1150n 0.5 1200n 0.5]
Vclk (clk 0) vsource type=pulse val0=0 val1=0.9 period=30n width=14.9n delay=11.95n rise=100p fall=100p
Vrst (rst 0) vsource type=pwl wave=[0 0 540.95n 0 541.05n 0.9 656.95n 0.9 657.05n 0 855.95n 0 856.05n 0.9 877.95n 0.9 878.05n 0 1200n 0]

XDUT (vin clk rst out) dt_lowpass_sampler

simulatorOptions options reltol=1e-6 vabstol=1e-8 iabstol=1e-12
tran tran stop=1200n maxstep=50p strobeperiod=50p errpreset=moderate strobeoutput=strobeonly
save vin clk rst out

name: dc-start
purpose: vin starts at 0.6 V so the filter starts in equilibrium (first sample at 6 ns); irregular clock with bursts inside one update interval, a 229 ns gap across two updates, and samples 0.6 ns before or after an update instant; a two-sample reset during a ramp, a one-sample reset pulse, reset held to the end

name: tupdate-override
purpose: tupdate = 130 ns; regular 45 ns clock; vin starts at -0.3 V; a full-scale step 80 ns before an update; a six-sample reset across a step and a slow ramp
netlist:
simulator lang=spectre
global 0

ahdl_include "dut.va"

Vvin (vin 0) vsource type=pwl wave=[0 -0.3 50.5n -0.3 51.5n 1 350.5n 1 351.5n -0.8 700n -0.8 1000n 0.6 1199.5n 0.6 1200.5n -0.2 1500n -0.2]
Vclk (clk 0) vsource type=pulse val0=0 val1=0.9 period=45n width=19.9n delay=12.45n rise=100p fall=100p
Vrst (rst 0) vsource type=pwl wave=[0 0 299.95n 0 300.05n 0.9 589.95n 0.9 590.05n 0 1500n 0]

XDUT (vin clk rst out) dt_lowpass_sampler tupdate=130n

simulatorOptions options reltol=1e-6 vabstol=1e-8 iabstol=1e-12
tran tran stop=1500n maxstep=50p strobeperiod=50p errpreset=moderate strobeoutput=strobeonly
save vin clk rst out

name: vth-tr-override
purpose: vth 0.8 V and tr 100 ps with 180 ps clock edges: every sample crossing lies 2.5 ps before a 25 ps grid row, so a scored row falls 127.5 ps after each event, inside (1.25*tr, 1.3*tr), and a 0.45 V threshold samples 70 ps early; vin starts at 0.5 V; negative held values; a two-sample reset across an update, a one-sample reset pulse, a short rst pulse between samples, reset held to the end; 25 ps grid
netlist:
simulator lang=spectre
global 0

ahdl_include "dut.va"

Vvin (vin 0) vsource type=pwl wave=[0 0.5 60.5n 0.5 61.5n -0.7 340.5n -0.7 341.5n 0.9 480.5n 0.9 481.5n -0.4 660n -0.4 760n 0.6 900n 0.6]
Vclk (clk 0) vsource type=pulse val0=0 val1=0.9 period=30n width=14.9n delay=11.8625n rise=0.18n fall=0.18n
Vrst (rst 0) vsource type=pwl wave=[0 0 289.95n 0 290.05n 0.9 344.95n 0.9 345.05n 0 524.95n 0 525.05n 0.9 529.95n 0.9 530.05n 0 639.95n 0 640.05n 0.9 644.95n 0.9 645.05n 0 849.95n 0 850.05n 0.9 900n 0.9]

XDUT (vin clk rst out) dt_lowpass_sampler vth=0.8 tr=100p

simulatorOptions options reltol=1e-6 vabstol=1e-8 iabstol=1e-12
tran tran stop=900n maxstep=25p strobeperiod=25p errpreset=moderate strobeoutput=strobeonly
save vin clk rst out
